variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. The event places representation at the centre of public attention. The assessment of {target} should distinguish the holding of an election from any claim about what its result authorises.

A working person's vote deserves the same respect as anyone else's. What matters to labour is whether representation takes wages, safe work and household needs seriously. An election gives those concerns a political setting; it does not make the work of defending them unnecessary.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
